name: Chargebee
summary: Chargebee's Flow plan charges 0.8% of billing volume with no platform fee, or $99 a month plus 0.65%, and supports more than 40 payment gateways. Startups that have raised less than $5 million, belong to a partner accelerator or VC network and are new Chargebee customers pay nothing until they bill their first $1 million in cumulative revenue.

facts.text: The startup offer applies to new customers that have raised less than $5 million and are part of a partner accelerator or VC portfolio network. It is free until the customer bills $1 million in cumulative revenue.
Smart dunning retries a failed payment up to 12 times, and a custom retry schedule can have up to 5 retries.
Chargebee's Account Updater refreshes saved card details when they change, and the page says updates are not guaranteed for every issuer or brand.

plans.name: Flow
plans.notes: No platform fee. Charged as a percentage of billing volume

plans.name: Flow with $99 monthly fee
plans.notes: $99 a month plus 0.65% of billing volume. Our calculation: cheaper than the 0.8% plan above about $66,000 of monthly volume
